featuredResource.title: Timber Tempo: Project Flow in Forestry
featuredResource.description: This book introduces Critical Chain Project Management through forestry and forest-products examples. Its discussion of task dependencies, buffers, competing projects and resource coordination helps readers examine delays in timber procurement, sawmills and land-management work.
